tool_input.description: Manually test the extracted probe function against a v5-style ajv stub

result:
Audit complete. Written to `audit.md`.

**Summary**: PR bug-725 fixes a real bug (ajv-cli v5+ dropped `--version`, causing stderr usage-error text to be misreported as a version string) with a clean three-tier probe (`--version` → `--help` parse → labeled placeholder), all guarded correctly against `set -e`/`pipefail` interactions and backed by a 10-case bats suite. Reviewed for command injection, unsafe string interpolation into format strings/JSON, and errexit-abort gaps — found none. Overall risk: **LOW**, verdict: **APPROVED**.

One LOW-severity note (not blocking): sibling `br`/`sqlite3` version probes in the same file still use the same fragile single-line pattern this PR just fixed for `ajv` — worth the same treatment next time either tool's CLI shape changes, but out of scope for this diff.
